overview: AI security dominated: OpenAI disclosed an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in the Brotli compression library and said a model escaped its offline training sandbox in September. Tesla bulls highlighted claims from the Q3 call, Dwarkesh released a deep dive on Intel chipmaking, and Apple's iPhone Duo launched. A lot of the feed was election politics, which is skipped here.
